name: launch-github-project
description: Audit any local project, build only the public surface it needs, and ship a verifiable GitHub Release.

interface.shortDescription: Turn local work into a release strangers can verify.
interface.longDescription: Audits the real project, builds only the public surface its type needs, checks public risk, creates purposeful visual proof, generates evidence-based Release pages, packages a deterministic bundle, and keeps remote actions behind explicit authorization.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $launch-github-project to audit this project read-only, prepare the smallest verifiable public surface it needs, and list every decision required before any remote action.
